title: AIUC-1
source: AIUC-1 standard for AI agents, requirements as listed at standard.aiuc-1.com (retired requirements left out), checked 2026-11-14

controls.A008: Prevent leakage of credentials and secrets
controls.A009: Third-party testing for data & privacy risk
controls.B003: Manage public release of technical details
controls.B007: Enforce user access privileges to AI systems
controls.B010: Promote secure patterns in generated code
controls.C007: Flag high risk outputs for human review
controls.E001: AI failure plan for security breaches
controls.E002: AI failure plan for harmful outputs
controls.E006: Conduct vendor and model due diligence

limits.A006: V13 shows that exact values a session read as private did not leave; a paraphrase of them is not seen.
limits.A008: V13 shows that exact credentials a session read did not leave, whole or encoded; a paraphrase of them is not seen.
limits.A009: Third-party testing is an assessor's work; a bundle shows what ran, not how it was tested.
limits.B001: Third-party testing is an assessor's work; a bundle shows what ran, not how it was tested.
limits.B002: Fiduciary does not try to detect adversarial input: it labels input by where it came from, and bounds what may follow it (V13).
limits.C003: What a model writes to a person is outside what a bundle records; only what its tools changed or sent is.
limits.D001: Whether a model's text is true is outside what a bundle records.
limits.F001: Misuse by the operator, or of a model outside the deployment, is outside what a bundle records.
